items.caption: 3 things that are stealing your peace #peace #home #declutter #tidy #homeorganization @braun_global @braun_us
items.transcript: Here are three things that are stealing your peace at home. Tell us how you stay so peaceful, sweetie. Starting with noise and electronics in your bedroom. Checking your phone before bed and first thing in the morning causes an immediate spike in your cortisol levels. If you can, swap out your phone for a digital alarm clock. I place my alarm clock away from my bed so it forces me to get up and wake up. And if you live right next to a busy street, having a sound machine will instantly cancel out the noise. Bathroom clutter. It's time to remove everything but the bathroom sink because all of that visual clutter actually causes a lot of cognitive overload. So if you don't have a lot of surface area on your bathroom sink, use vanity organizers and keep them in your medicine cabinet. And to make your morning and nighttime routines more seamless, line up your products in the order that you use them. But the ultimate thing that's really stealing your peace is having too much inventory. Maybe you have too many towels. Maybe it's too many mugs. Maybe it's too many linens. Because the more stuff you own, the more you have to clean and tend to it.

items.transcript: Here's something you might overlook, self-care does not always have to take place in the bathroom. In fact, when you place self-care items where you're more likely to use them, this will actually turn an action into a habit. For instance, if you want to keep your skin more hydrated and dewy throughout the day, keep a hydrating mist at your desk. Here's a totally random one, maybe not so random, I keep my sheet masks in my fridge and I will have it stack, I'll wear one while I'm cooking. In my entryway, I keep a little makeup caddy for quick touch-ups before I leave the apartment, I have some perfume, and this is my favorite new lip to cheek product by Kosas. And finally, I like to keep my LED mask in my living room, I'm more likely to use it here because I will just pop it on and read a magazine or a book or watch TV. I love that I can still see through the eye area and then it has this fun holster so I can wear it if I'm walking around.
